features.name: Portfolio Diversification Index
features.description: Measures cross-sectional dispersion of stock returns as a proxy for diversification effectiveness.

variables.r_{i,t}: daily log return of stock i on date t calculated as log(div_adj_close_{i,t}/div_adj_close_{i,t-1})
variables.std_i(r_{i,t}): cross-sectional standard deviation of daily returns across all valid stocks in the portfolio universe at date t

features.interpretation: High values indicate uneven return distribution (lower diversification), low values indicate uniform returns (better diversification)

features.name: Market Leadership Concentration Score
features.description: Measures concentration of portfolio performance in top-performing stocks using relative return dominance.

variables.R_t: equal-weight portfolio return on date t calculated as mean_i(r_{i,t})
variables.Top_10%_R_t: average daily return of top 10% stocks by r_{i,t} on date t

features.interpretation: High values indicate performance is driven by a small subset of stocks, low values indicate broad-based performance

features.name: Momentum Shift Frequency
features.description: Counts transitions between positive and negative momentum regimes in portfolio returns.

variables.R_rolling_5d_t: equal-weight 5-day rolling return of the portfolio ending on date t

features.interpretation: High values indicate frequent momentum regime shifts, low values indicate stable momentum direction

features.name: Volatility Regime Stability
features.description: Measures consistency in portfolio volatility patterns over time.

variables.sigma_20d_t: equal-weight 20-day rolling standard deviation of daily returns ending on date t

features.interpretation: High values indicate unstable volatility patterns, low values indicate consistent volatility clustering

features.name: Portfolio Regime Transition Frequency
features.description: Counts transitions between distinct market states based on return thresholds.

variables.R_rolling_20d_t: equal-weight 20-day rolling return of the portfolio ending on date t

features.interpretation: High values indicate frequent regime changes, low values indicate stable market conditions

features.name: Systematic Risk Amplification Index
features.description: Measures correlation between portfolio returns and equal-weighted benchmark proxy.

variables.R_t: equal-weight portfolio return on date t calculated as mean_i(r_{i,t})
variables.B_t: equal-weight average return of all companies in the portfolio universe on date t

features.interpretation: High absolute values indicate strong systematic risk alignment with market-wide movements

features.name: Recovery Velocity Index
features.description: Measures average time to recover from drawdowns in portfolio value.

variables.D_i,t: number of days from peak to recovery for stock i on date t

features.interpretation: Lower values indicate faster recovery from losses, higher values indicate prolonged drawdowns

features.name: Liquidity Correlation Intensity
features.description: Measures synchronization of liquidity shocks across portfolio stocks.

variables.V_sigma_20d,i: 20-day rolling standard deviation of volume for stock i ending on date t

features.interpretation: High positive values indicate synchronized liquidity risk, low values indicate independent liquidity patterns

features.name: Sentiment Coherence Score
features.description: Measures alignment between portfolio returns and equal-weighted benchmark proxy.

variables.R_t: equal-weight portfolio return on date t calculated as mean_i(r_{i,t})
variables.B_t: equal-weight average return of all companies in the portfolio universe on date t

features.interpretation: High absolute values indicate strong alignment with market-wide sentiment patterns

features.name: Risk Contribution Uniformity Index
features.description: Measures dispersion of individual stock volatility contributions to portfolio risk.

variables.sigma_i,t: 20-day rolling standard deviation of daily returns for stock i ending on date t

features.interpretation: High values indicate uneven risk contributions (lower uniformity), low values indicate balanced risk distribution

features.name: Portfolio Regime Adaptability Index
features.description: Measures performance consistency across different volatility regimes.

variables.R_high_t: portfolio return during periods where 20-day rolling sigma > 1%
variables.R_low_t: portfolio return during periods where 20-day rolling sigma ≤ 1%

features.interpretation: High values indicate better performance in volatile conditions, low values indicate poor adaptability

features.name: Information Flow Dominance Metric
features.description: Measures correlation between price changes and volume spikes as information proxy.

variables.r_{i,t}: daily log return of stock i on date t calculated as log(div_adj_close_{i,t}/div_adj_close_{i,t-1})
variables.V_sigma_5d,i: 5-day rolling standard deviation of volume for stock i ending on date t

features.interpretation: High positive values indicate strong information-driven price movements, low values indicate noise dominance

features.name: Dynamic Correlation Stability
features.description: Measures persistence of pairwise stock correlations over time.

variables.corr_ij_t: 20-day rolling correlation between daily returns of stock i and stock j ending on date t

features.interpretation: High values indicate unstable correlations, low values indicate persistent inter-stock relationships

features.name: Tail Risk Exposure Concentration
features.description: Measures dispersion of extreme return events across portfolio stocks.

variables.R_quantile_1pct_t: portfolio-wide 1% quantile return on date t
variables.r_{i,t}: daily log return of stock i on date t calculated as log(div_adj_close_{i,t}/div_adj_close_{i,t-1})

features.interpretation: High values indicate concentrated tail risk exposure, low values indicate diversified extreme risks

features.name: Portfolio Entropy of Returns
features.description: Measures unpredictability in portfolio return distribution using information entropy.

variables.p_r: probability distribution of equal-weight average returns over the most recent 60 trading days

features.interpretation: High values indicate chaotic/unordered return patterns, low values indicate structured behavior
